name: Mistral API Experiment tier
amount: Free API access to Mistral's models at low rate limits (third-party reports: about 1B tokens/month, 1 request/second)
summary: Free tier on Mistral's API platform, described as being for experimentation, evaluation and prototyping. Mistral no longer publishes the limits; they're shown in the account console.
source_note: Mistral docs and third-party reports, 2026-09-28. Usage terms and data use still to be read; model list and daily tests follow once an API key is configured.
